title: Acquire certified global intervals from three LMIs and exact free witnesses
statement: For c>=1 global comparison holds iff c T_i-S_i>=0 for i=1,2,3. For 0<=c<1 it holds iff a real center z makes B_i=c T_i-S_i-(1-c)(z-x_i)(z-x_i)^T>=0 for all three i. Substitute a=(1-c)z to obtain three 3x3 LMIs affine in c,a. Rational PSD principal-minor checks certify every returned upper bound; rational Gram inverse-quadratic ratios certify lower bounds.

requires: Explicit positive rational K,L at a classical/dephasing input boundary; L must be informative (rank two on zero-sum inputs). Arbitrary finite complex noncommuting reference effects are allowed. Conditional/equal-reference semantics and free formula are inherited N965/N970/N1038 priors.
provides: For c>=1 global comparison holds iff c T_i-S_i>=0 for i=1,2,3. For 0<=c<1 it holds iff a real center z makes B_i=c T_i-S_i-(1-c)(z-x_i)(z-x_i)^T>=0 for all three i. Substitute a=(1-c)z to obtain three 3x3 LMIs affine in c,a. Rational PSD principal-minor checks certify every returned upper bound; rational Gram inverse-quadratic ratios certify lower bounds.
assumptions: No extension to zero channel entries, noninjective L or general coherent quantum-input channels. Tight width/runtime for every rational bit length is not proved. Adversarial anisotropic L leaves X68 a valid wide interval; selected X13 passed the nineteen reviewer probes. Frozen X68 batch checker accepted missing/duplicate coverage; separately credited post-review repair passed ten independent regressions and does not rewrite frozen outcomes. Generic free-convex/SOS machinery is historical prior; specialization priority UNKNOWN. Earlier SN-N1038-REVIEWED-SCOPE-20261026 records the former in-principle formula: its algorithmic gap is now closed only at this 3x3 interface, not uniformly for arbitrary alphabets.
costs: Numerical optimization proposes; exact rational PSD minors and inverse quadratic witnesses establish bounds. Charge startup/imports, acquisition, checking, conditioning and serialization. Local reviewed thirteen-case process observations do not imply a uniform time/precision guarantee. Active-two is not total reference-two; faithful vacuum realization may converge slowly. No state-preparation or physical advantage acquired.
contract.units: Exact rational matrices, dimensionless divergence ratios and discrepancies; process timings are local seconds, not uniform complexity bounds.
contract.obstruction: Improve certificate acquisition under extreme conditioning and compare with historical SOS including independent lower acquisition and full setup/checking costs. Preserve earlier equality/binary/finite-formula/refinement credit.

body: The exact residual is (1-c)(X-zI)(X-zI)*+sum_i B_i tensor Q_i. Positivity therefore holds at all complex matrix levels. The small moment primal has a strict feasible point and attained dual with multiplier offdiagonal b=-(1-c)z, proving completeness rather than merely a sufficient heuristic. Numerical eigensolvers/SDP propose rounded center and effects; exact checks decide acceptance or keep a broader proved bound. A rational square-root bracket certifies vertex maxima. Public runnable code: channel/evaluate.py INPUT.json OUTPUT.json then channel/verify_result.py INPUT.json OUTPUT.json relative to the preserved packet channel directory.
